title.full: Aged 60 and above and feeling unwell

summary.text: If you get respiratory infection symptoms, or they are severe, long-lasting or getting worse, see your doctor.

details.heading: Why it matters
details.body: People aged 65 and above, and people with chronic illnesses, are at greater risk of severe disease or complications from COVID-19.

sources.page_title: I am a patient ≥ 60 years old. What should I do if I become unwell?

quotes.text: Medically vulnerable persons (i.e. elderly persons aged 65 years and above and those with chronic medical conditions) are at greater risk of severe disease or complications when infected with COVID-19.
If you develop ARI symptoms, or have severe, prolonged or worsening ARI symptoms, you should consult your doctor for medical management.
